subject: EU MAP — cross-border data governance & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@datasafe.it>; procurement@greenbank.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: EU MAP — cross-border data governance & evaluation timeline

Hi Elena / GreenBank team,

Thanks for taking the time on the discovery call last week. As discussed, I’m kicking off the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the EU cross-border data residency review and the evaluation track leading to a November close target (high level).

Attached: GreenBank_MAP_template_v1.xlsx — it contains a suggested roles matrix, milestone dates, and an evaluation checklist. Please do one pass and indicate owners for each line.

Primary objectives for this MAP:
- Confirm data residency boundaries (EU + UK) and permitted cross-border flows
- Surface any contractual or technical gaps for KMS / HSM, audit logs, and retention
- Agree an evaluation plan (P0 integration tests, P1 privacy/controls review) and a realistic close timeline

Requesting the following from GreenBank by EOD Tue (local):
1) A designated procurement owner for contract touchpoints (billing / T&Cs)
2) Technical lead for data residency proofs (network/region constraints)
3) Security/compliance lead for questionnaire items and evidence intake

Proposed internal owners (we can reassign):
- Program lead / MAP coordination: me (Soòjin Lee)
- Evaluation plan & test coordinator: Monica Patel (CS)
- Legal / compliance intake: Rishi Malhotra
- Solution architecture / region mapping: Aditya Rao
- Executive sponsor for escalation: Laura Bennett (GD)

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm roles plus availability for a 30-min MAP alignment call (Wed/Thu)
- Monica: I’ll loop you in for evaluation plan scoping
- Rishi: please flag any initial contractual blockers you anticipate

Attachments: GreenBank_MAP_template_v1.xlsx

Regards,

Soòjin Lee
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@datasafe.it>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, procurement@greenbank.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:44:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EU MAP — cross-border data governance & evaluation timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — received and reviewed the template. GreenBank will assign owners as follows:
- Procurement: Martin Dupont (martin.dupont@eu-consulting.com) — copied on a separate thread for SOW/pricing coordination
- Technical lead: Marco Bianchi (marco.bianchi@greenbank.com) — will provide a region/network inventory
- Security/compliance: Elena Rossi (me) — I’ll coordinate the questionnaire and evidence pack

A couple of immediate flags from a GDPR / local regulator perspective:
- Any cross-border flows into US-based systems will require a clear lawful basis and SCC mapping (we prefer solutions that can isolate EU processing)
- We will need to validate key management: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) or HSM-backed keys; please list supported KMS integrations and whether Redwood supports region-bound KMS.

I can do a short alignment call Wednesday 17 Nov at 09:00 CET or Thursday 18 Nov 11:00 CET. Which do you prefer?

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Data Protection, GreenBank (EMEA)
elena.rossi@datasafe.it

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@datasafe.it>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU MAP — cross-border data governance & evaluation timeline

Elena — thanks for the quick feedback and for flagging SCC/KMS concerns. A few clarifications from legal/compliance perspective:

1) KMS/HSM: Redwood supports both cloud-native KMS (customer-managed keys) and dedicated HSM integrations for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted API customers we offer a region-restricted key option and have an HSM-backed offering on Dedicated with attestations. Monica — I’ll follow up offline with the matrix of supported providers.

2) Audit logs and retention: We’ll need to reconcile GreenBank’s retention policy with our default telemetry retention. Please share a short CSV or a reference doc of retention periods for logs + backups. We can include exception language in the MAP if needed.

3) SCCs / legal flow: If GreenBank requires SCC mapping for subprocessors, please confirm whether you want a data flow diagram and a list of subprocessors per region. We can produce both.

I recommend the Wed 09:00 CET call (works for me).

—Rishi
Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@datasafe.it>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0500
Subject: Re: EU MAP — cross-border data governance & evaluation timeline

Elena / team — great, thanks. I’m taking point on the evaluation plan. High-level proposal (first cut):

Phase A — Evidence & design review (Week 1)
- Deliverables: data flow diagram (Redwood + customer), list of substantiated subprocessors by region, KMS options doc
- Owner: Marco (GreenBank) + Aditya (Redwood)

Phase B — Controlled integration tests (Week 2)
- Deliverables: sample dataset ingest (anonymized), regional routing validation, latency profiling for EU-only routing
- Owner: Monica (test plan) + Marco (executes)

Phase C — Security review & signoff (Week 3)
- Deliverables: questionnaire answers, audit log export, retention confirmation, legal redlines for SCCs
- Owner: Elena + Rishi

Proposed timeline to close: target sign-off by end of Week 3 (we understand this is ambitious; we can stretch to Week 5 if evidence gathering takes longer).

Action items for the call Wed 17 Nov 09:00 CET:
- Confirm owners in the MAP spreadsheet (Soòjin will update live)
- Agree on anonymized dataset for integration test and who will host test environment
- Rishi to list minimum legal artifacts required for SCC mapping

I’ve added an internal checklist and suggested test scripts in the shared Drive (link to follow in the meeting invite). Also attaching DataSafeguards_Summary.pdf for the initial read.

—Monica
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — productive alignment today. Quick recap and owners (I updated the MAP spreadsheet in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/GreenBank/MAP/GB-2026-047):

- Owners confirmed: Procurement = Martin Dupont; Tech = Marco Bianchi; Security = Elena Rossi
- Redwood owners: Soojin (MAP lead), Monica (eval), Rishi (legal), Aditya (arch)
